baseline_diagnosis.quality_metric: signed common raw-E1 omega1 loss relative to each baseline x_1600
baseline_diagnosis.exit: transition from loss <= band at x_(k-1) to loss > band at x_k
baseline_diagnosis.persistent_entry: earliest k after which the condition remains true through baseline k=1600

hypothesis_classification.STABILIZATION_HYPOTHESIS_SUPPORTED: post-entry exits on the mesh coincide repeatedly with move-saturated/reversing update events while the trajectory later returns to the same high-quality N=2 basin without a persistent topology/connectivity or solver failure
hypothesis_classification.STABILIZATION_HYPOTHESIS_PLAUSIBLE: the trajectory leaves and revisits a high-quality N=2 basin and update aggressiveness is a credible contributor, but event association is mixed or sparse
hypothesis_classification.STABILIZATION_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED: exits are primarily explained by basin/topology/solver changes, or no recurrent high-quality basin is observed

experiment_gate.required_to_proceed: hypothesis is SUPPORTED or PLAUSIBLE on at least three of four meshes
experiment_gate.if_not_met: do not run a continuation experiment
experiment_gate.observed_before_candidate_freeze: met: SUPPORTED on 320x40 and 400x50; PLAUSIBLE on 160x20 and 240x30

candidate_trigger.counter_reset: reset to zero whenever condition is false and immediately after each move reduction
candidate_trigger.reduction_effect: when the counter reaches 100 on the current pre-update native state, apply the next move limit to that same outer update
candidate_trigger.rationale: one hundred consecutive native bimodal states guards against the documented transient entries while remaining a single simple resolution-independent condition; no common evaluator or future state is used

stage_a.cap_semantics: observation cap only; neither trigger nor cap is convergence
stage_a.selection_rule: eliminate candidates with solver/connectivity/modal failure, material raw/binary quality loss, or trivial freezing; otherwise prefer the simplest candidate that materially advances persistent quality without tiny-difference ranking

selected_candidates.selection_reason: simplest healthy stabilization; persistent high raw and late binary quality
bounded stronger stabilization retained to test excursion-prone hold-outs; healthy and high-quality on calibration

rejected_development_candidate.reason: SOLVER_FAILURE at outer iteration 1316; no hold-out authorization

primary_success.metric: baseline persistent crossing minus stabilized persistent crossing
primary_success.required: materially earlier persistent quality on multiple meshes while retaining N=2, persistent gap<=1%, raw/binary quality, connectivity, volume, and solver health

guardrails: no candidate family beyond the bounded S0-S3 ceiling
